name: Starship Catastrophic Damage
description: Rogue Trader, Table 8-12, result 11 (p. 222). Rolled when a starship suffers Catastrophic Damage.

results.name: Space Hulk
results.text: The ship is left a drifting, smouldering wreck. Roll [[1d10]] for each Component: on 1-2 it is untouched but unpowered, on 3-7 it is depressurised and damaged, on 9-10 it is destroyed and everyone inside is killed. Crew Population drops to [[1d10]].

results.name: Plasma Drive Explosion
results.text: Every starship within [[1d10]] VUs must pass a Hard (-20) Pilot (Space Craft) + Manoeuvrability Test or be struck by flaming debris: [[1d5]] macrobattery hits doing [[1d10+4]] damage each, against which void shields and armour protect normally.

results.name: Warp Drive Explosion
results.text: Every starship within [[2d10]] VUs must pass a Hard (-20) Pilot (Space Craft) + Manoeuvrability Test or take one lance strike of [[1d10]] damage that void shields do not stop. Every starship within [[1d5]] VUs must also pass a Challenging (+0) Pilot (Space Craft) + Manoeuvrability Test or be pulled into the rift.
